capability.title: Payment Method Management
capability.description: Registers provider-backed types and lets administrators localize, activate and prioritize payment methods, assign fees and constrain availability.

capability.title: Checkout Payment Selection
capability.description: Adds payment selection to order workflows, filters unavailable methods, supports currency switching and handles zero-value orders as free.

capability.title: Payment Gateway Processing
capability.description: Provides provider-neutral gateway displays, callback routing and success, cancellation or error detection for external payment flows.

capability.title: Recurring Payment Support
capability.description: Defines a provider-neutral lifecycle for creating, capturing, cancelling, suspending and resuming recurring payment subscriptions.

capability.title: Built-in Payment Methods
capability.description: Provides cash, invoice, advance and standard payment methods and provisions the common methods during package installation.
